dedupe_keys.name: pressure monitoring dataset and frequency domain analysis in padua water distribution network

description: Silvia Meniconi and colleagues from the University of Perugia and AcegasApsAmga publish high-frequency pressure measurements from the Padua water-distribution network. The deposit contains a twenty-four-hour signal from measurement section P036 and frequency-domain analyses of three pressure datasets. The metadata identify fre as the sampling-frequency variable and omega as the analysed frequency range. Zenodo serves P036_data.mat and frequency_analysis.mat free under CC BY 4.0, with a November 2023 publication date. The actual measurement date, numeric sampling rate and spatial extent represented by the sensors remain unknown from the short description. The signals can help calibrate transient behaviour or compare spectral diagnostics in hydraulic models, but a one-day measurement window does not establish long-term operating variation. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The MAT files were not opened or processed.
